newsitem.title: USA: Pride Petroleum to buy Forasol-Foramer for $281 million.
newsitem.headline: Pride Petroleum to buy Forasol-Foramer for $281 million.

text.p: Pride Petroleum Services said Monday it agreed to acquire Forasol-Foramer N.V., an oil drilling contractor, for $281 million.
Under the agreement, Forasol stockholders would swap one Forasol share for 0.66 share in the Houston-based oil well service and drilling contractor Pride Petroleum plus $6.80 in cash.
Following the news, Forasol's stock gained $2 to $15.875, while Pride Petroleum was up 75 cents at $16 on the Nasdaq market.
Belgian holding company Ackermans & van Haaren has a 30 percent interest in Forasol, and the French firm Soletanche also has 30 percent. The rest of Forasol's stock are publicly traded.

"The acquisition of Forasol will increase the percentage of our revenues generated from offshore operations from approximately 13 percent to 30 percent," said Ray Tolson, chairman and chief executive officer of Pride Petroleum.
"It will add significant additional capabilities to the range of services and equipment we can offer our customers," he said.
The acquisition is expected to be completed in the first quarter of next year.
